annotations.title: Draft Agent Response Groundedness & Hallucination Auditor

description: Cross-references factual claims, numbers, and citations in a draft agent response against retrieved source passages to flag unsupported hallucinations before delivery. Use when verifying that a generated answer is 100% grounded in source evidence before returning it to the user; for scrubbing inbound tool outputs for prompt-injection and invisible Unicode, use sanitize_tool_output_stream instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'claim' ('context' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

claim.description: Draft agent response or factual statement to verify for hallucinations.

context.description: Authoritative source text or retrieved RAG passages that the claim must be grounded in.

strictness.description: Entailment threshold required for numbers and dates; defaults to 'exact_entailment' when omitted.

name: audit_response_factuality

groundedness_score.description: Factual support ratio from 0.0 (fabricated) to 1.0 (fully entailed).

unverified_claims.description: Hallucinated or unsupported assertions flagged for removal.

verified_claims.description: Assertions directly entailed by the provided source context.
